item.title: The Deterministic Problem with Probabilistic AI Analytics
item.description: TLDR: AI-powered analytics tools use probabilistic systems (LLMs, semantic search, RAG) to answer business questions that demand deterministic accuracy. Ask the same question twice with slightly different wording, and you might get different SQL queries and different answers. This isn't a minor bug - it's a fundamental architectural problem.
